Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. programme.title: Maria Cinta Yang Hilang
programme.desc: A brave, poor young girl is welcomed into a rich family and develops a romance with their misogynist youngest son, driving a woman already in love with him to go to great lengths to destroy their relationship.

programme.title: Istri Paruh Waktu
programme.desc: Riska and Adimas seem to have a perfect marriage with a child. But family pressure and Riska’s busy life strain their relationship, leading Adimas into an affair. When the truth emerges, Riska fights to save her family amid conflict and heartbreak.

programme.title: Di Sini Ada Yang Mati
programme.desc: Sarah, Jasmine, and Lydia always help each other if one is hit by the problem. At one point, Lydia complained to Jasmine and Sarah that she was expecting. The child was the result of his relationship with Christian, Lydia's ex- lover.

programme.title: Customs Protection
programme.desc: This reality TV show, which follows the daily lives of several customs officers, not only lets viewers witness Indonesia’s Customs and Excise Agency in action during raids, but also takes us behind the scenes to see what actually happens on the ground.
In the 86 program, viewers will be invited to see the daily lives of several police officers.

programme.title: My Sassy Psychic
programme.desc: My Sassy Psychic tells the story of a girl named Sonklin who was involved in an accident with her mother. After the accident, Sonklin gained a sixth sense, allowing her to see spirits and discern a person's life history through the touch of a hand. Because of this ability, Sonklin opened a practice she calls the Goddess Sonklin's Palace.

programme.title: Di Balik Mitos
programme.desc: This show reveals the truth of a mystery and phenomena beyond reason.

programme.title: Top Spot
programme.desc: This program discusses information from within and outside the country in a light and entertaining manner. It is presented sequentially, according to an interesting and informative theme.

programme.title: Jelajah Masjid Nusantara
programme.desc: A travel documentary series that takes viewers on a journey to explore mosques across Indonesia, uncovering their history, architecture, and the cultural and religious significance they embody.

programme.title: AADD: Ada Apa Dengan Dunia
programme.desc: What's happening in the world today? All the events and tragedies currently happening around the world will be summarized clearly and up-to-date. Only on Net TV!
